title: 36 Hours in Paris: On the Seine
abstract: The river doesn’t just wind through the heart of Paris — it is the city’s heart. Where to dine, drink and play along the photogenic waterway — with pit stops for art, shopping and simply gazing.

title: 36 Hours in Lugano
abstract: Lugano, in Ticino, Switzerland’s Italian-speaking canton, has its own distinctive culinary, wine and cultural scene, not to mention casinos and serene views across an alpine lake.

title: 36 Hours in Tucson
abstract: Foodies, cyclists and the aesthetically inclined will find much to like in this desert city, home to a new bike-share system, adobe architecture and restaurants that reflect a mix of cultural influences.

title: 36 Hours in Montreal
abstract: Canada’s second-largest city has an atmospheric Old Town that everyone flocks to, but there are also outlying neighborhoods to explore, along with natural wine bars, street art and pop-up markets.
